checks.title: Direct fetch calls stay in API adapters
checks.details: Scanned 455 client files for direct fetch/globalThis.fetch/window.fetch/self.fetch calls. API adapters are api/, apiclient/, src/api/. Aliases and other network libraries require review; local-file and OAuth fetch calls also require architectural review.

checks.title: Canonical username regex parity
checks.details: Compares literal username regex in canonical client helper and backend username schema only. Length, normalization, email, password and runtime validation remain manual review.

checks.title: Declared deep-link destinations resolve to Expo routes
checks.details: Resolved 22 declared ROUTE_MAP destinations against 180 Expo source files. This does not prove authorization, parameter safety, or that every screen should be externally linkable.

checks.title: Webhook replay and concurrent delivery safety
checks.details: Manual review required: execute duplicate and concurrent delivery tests and inspect unique constraints and transaction boundaries. Presence of a dedup marker cannot prove duplicate-safe writes.

checks.title: Sensitive admin actions produce durable audit events
checks.details: Manual review required: exercise each sensitive admin action and verify actor, target and outcome in durable logs, including logger failure. Nearby log calls alone do not prove complete coverage.

checks.title: Payment state is owned by verified server transitions
checks.details: Manual review required: tamper with client payment fields and verify backend rejects changes; inspect receipt/signature validation and ownership. Source scanning cannot establish trusted state transitions.
